disposition: PROPOSED — owner/reviewer disposition required; no row adopted by appearance
status: informative R21 machine-readable mirror generated from the reviewed row source and bound to docs/GKOS_ISO42001_NIST_AIRMF_CROSSWALK.md; grants no profile claim, certification, alignment, or outcome assertion

iso_42001.note: No rows emitted until Annex A identifiers and titles are verified against legitimately accessed final ISO/IEC 42001:2023 text.

nist_ai_rmf.title: NIST AI 100-1, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
nist_ai_rmf.external_baseline_status: AI RMF 1.0 current baseline; revised AI RMF in progress as checked 2026-09-03

nist_relationship_classes.Direct evidence candidate: A GKOS-mandated artifact can directly contribute evidence toward the RMF outcome; sufficiency is an organizational determination.
nist_relationship_classes.Contributes: Relevant but partial; substantial additional organizational evidence required.
nist_relationship_classes.Deployment-declared: GKOS mandates the record or hook; the organization supplies policy, threshold, authority, risk tolerance, or legal basis.
nist_relationship_classes.No direct mapping: No defensible correspondence; recorded explicitly. A positive result, not a defect.
nist_relationship_classes.Superseded: Requirement superseded in the current development line; see replacement.

control_rule: A mapping-rule example does not authorize automatic assignment of that subcategory to every member of a GKOS family; every row is adjudicated independently.

GKOS-CONFORMANCE-001.note: Documents what was not measured; MEASURE 1.1 asks for exactly this disclosure.

GKOS-CONFORMANCE-002.note: Blocks over-claiming; sufficiency of the claim boundary is organizational.

GKOS-CONFORMANCE-003.note: Fixture/adapter boundary rule does not require independent AI-system assessment; no direct RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-IDENTITY-001.note: Identifier format rule; no RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-IDENTITY-002.note: Legacy identifier validity; no RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-IDENTITY-004.note: Anti-inference rule for identifier ordering; important GKOS authority semantics, but no direct AI RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-LINEAGE-002.note: Derivation rule for invalid_at; technical only.

GKOS-LINEAGE-003.note: No silent authoritative selection; accountability for succession remains human.

GKOS-RECEIPT-001.note: Universal receipting is the core accountability record. MANAGE 4.3 NOT assigned to routine receipts.

GKOS-RECEIPT-002.note: Actor class in record evidences documented roles.

GKOS-RECEIPT-003.note: Receipt-binding failure handling supports reliable, accountable operation. Not MANAGE 2.4 or 4.1 by itself: transaction rollback is neither AI-system deactivation nor a post-deployment monitoring plan.

GKOS-POLICY-001.note: GKOS mandates explicit identity/version and blocks silent substitution; the organization supplies policy substance and determines whether trustworthiness is integrated.

GKOS-RETENTION-002.note: Documents the basis of a disposition.

GKOS-RETENTION-003.note: Avoidance response to indeterminate legal predicate; GKOS does not decide the obligation.

GKOS-REENTRY-001.note: Provenance preserved as property of the artifact.

GKOS-REENTRY-004.note: Explicit human or bounded-delegation supersession supports differentiated human-AI authority and accountability. Semantic knowledge supersession is not MANAGE 2.4 AI-system deactivation.

GKOS-DELEGATION-002.note: Major/indeterminate → prior human disposition is a planned risk response.

GKOS-DELEGATION-003.note: Raise-only nondeterministic checking is a GKOS control-integrity rule; no direct AI RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-DELEGATION-004.note: Superseded for v0.81 line; see GKOS-REVIEW-001..003.

GKOS-DELEGATION-005.note: Capability ≠ authority; no general write authority implied.

GKOS-DELEGATION-006.evidence_artifact: delegation freeze on overdue review; exception receipt
GKOS-DELEGATION-006.note: Overdue-review freeze and bounded exception contribute to human-AI oversight and monitoring/override. Not MANAGE 2.4 absent AI-system performance/outcome inconsistency.

GKOS-PROFILE-003.note: Intended use bounded: no consequential action under the claim.

GKOS-PROFILE-004.evidence_artifact: conformance-manifest (release, GKX, commit, fixtures, exceptions, assessment type)
GKOS-PROFILE-004.note: Complete claim binding. GOVERN 4.2 NOT assigned: manifest documents conformance status, not risk/impact.

GKOS-PROFILE-005.note: Executable negative evidence for fail-closed behavior supports reliability demonstration.

GKOS-PROFILE-006.note: No silent exclusion while retaining claim.

GKOS-PROFILE-007.note: Exposes provenance, epistemic state, contradictions, limitations to the reader.

GKOS-CANON-001.note: Determinism basis for inspectable artifacts. Not MEASURE 2.7.

GKOS-CANON-002.note: Prevents silent loss in the record.

GKOS-CANON-003.note: Numeric representation rule; no RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-CANON-004.note: Timestamp syntax and anti-ordering rule are technical canonicalization semantics; no direct AI RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-CANON-005.note: Text normalization rule; no RMF outcome nexus.

GKOS-CANON-007.evidence_artifact: SHA-256 canonical hash binding policy/compiler/selection refs
GKOS-CANON-007.note: Only CANON row retaining 2.7: integrity binding is security/resilience evidence.

GKOS-CANON-008.note: Human-readable round trip supports inspectability/accountability of GKOS artifacts; it does not by itself explain or validate an AI model under MEASURE 2.9.

GKOS-CONTEXT-001.note: Purpose, recipient, actors, omissions captured. MAP 1.6 removed (stakeholder requirements elicitation is not this).

GKOS-CONTEXT-004.note: Required disclosure in the presented context.

GKOS-CONTEXT-005.note: Exact material reviewed is bound to the disposition.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-001.note: Use bound to exact context hash.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-002.note: Integrity failure fails closed; 2.7 retained because mismatch is tamper/integrity evidence.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-003.note: Documents valid authority at action time and fail-closed treatment of invalid authority. Authority expiry/revocation alone is not MANAGE 2.4 AI-system deactivation.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-005.note: Gate closure documented with predicate and inputs.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-006.evidence_artifact: Authorized Use Record outcome + correction/rollback/escalation route
GKOS-AUTHUSE-006.note: Recovery and override route is the 4.1 nexus.

GKOS-AUTHUSE-007.note: Captured authority interval and refusal evidence contribute to accountability. Authority interval expiry alone is not MANAGE 2.4 AI-system deactivation.

GKOS-EFFECT-001.note: Scope of intended effect made explicit.

GKOS-EFFECT-002.note: Effect must sit within human-granted standing and delegation.

GKOS-REVIEW-002.evidence_artifact: append-only Decision Record bound to exact evidence

GKOS-REVIEW-003.evidence_artifact: role separation; different-model-family agent reviewer; sealed packet; human escalation
GKOS-REVIEW-003.note: No self-approval; differentiated human-AI roles and bounded human escalation. This is proposal review, not necessarily the regular AI-system assessment described by MEASURE 1.3.

GKOS-REVIEW-004.note: No silent rewriting. MANAGE 4.3 NOT assigned to routine dispositions.

GKOS-DISCLOSURE-001.note: Privacy and security outcomes; legal basis for protection is deployment-declared.
